pageProps.title: Bus Papercraft Solo Seedling in Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do
pageProps.content: ```adcard ``` Here is the location of the Bus Papercraft Solo Seedling in Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do in October 2026, around autumn. If it does not appear as a solo seedling, try turning on ```Seedling Search``` and moving around the area little by little. Overall, quite a few solo seedlings seem to appear around Anyang. If you explore around Anyang City Hall, you can also occasionally find Roadside solo seedlings, so keep that in mind. ```adcard ```
pageProps.address: Pyeongchon-daero, Burim-dong, Pyeongchon, Dongan-gu, Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do
